M-LINT-GIT.NAME: Lint changed-scope resolver
M-LINT-GIT.purpose: Resolve `lint --changed` scope from git (base/untracked) or explicit --files with path-safety checks.

fn-parseChangedFilesArg.PURPOSE: Parse comma/space separated --files; reject unsafe paths and sort/dedupe.

fn-resolveChangedFiles.PURPOSE: --files precedence; otherwise git diff + untracked, project-prefix aware.

fn-runGit.PURPOSE: Read-only git invocation with a 2 s timeout and typed failure messages.

CrossLink.relation: extracted from grace-lint.ts in v3.6.0; re-exported for compatibility

contract.purpose: Resolve `lint --changed` scope from git (base/untracked) or explicit --files with path-safety checks.

param.name: root
param.description: Project root (may be a subdirectory of a git repository).

param.name: scope
param.description: Sorted changed files plus scanned/skipped classification.

error.description: No git repository / invalid base / outside-project paths.

notes.note-1: Git is read-only (`diff --name-only`, `ls-files --others`); no index writes.
notes.note-2: Explicit --files works without git and is validated before use.
notes.note-3: The full detector set stays in M-LINT; this module only computes the scope.
